spec.title: Setup: build Lucene core at both #14732 revisions and run the landed index-sort range-query test
spec.description: Setup for case M01 (apache/lucene#14732) of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-brief.md, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links/worktrees (M01-lucene-fix = 5c886602, M01-lucene-parent = 36ddc378; Lucene 11.0.0-SNAPSHOT, minJava 24), runs the upstream ./gradlew (Gradle 8.14 and its wrapper jar checked against services.gradle.org by the setup session) on Temurin 24.0.2 (signature checked) with the cache's GRADLE_USER_HOME: builds lucene-core and runs TestIndexSortSortedNumericDocValuesRangeQuery with tests.seed=DEADBEEF, first on the fix online, then on the parent (its own copy) offline, then the parent with the fix's test class copied in (expected to fail testSameHitsAsPointRangeQueryIntSort, as the setup's overlay run did), then the fix again offline. Jars to .../artifacts with sha256, JUnit summaries to .../logs, build trees removed. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-brief-setup.md.
spec.expected: every step exits 0: both sides' own tests pass, the transplant fails testSameHitsAsPointRangeQueryIntSort, the fix's offline rerun passes

steps.name: M01-lucene-fix: lucene-core jar and the landed TestIndexSortSortedNumericDocValuesRangeQuery (online)
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; source $HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links/scripts/env.sh; mkdir -p $O/tmp $O/logs $O/artifacts; export JAVA_HOME=$O/tools/jdk-24.0.2+12; cd $W/M01-lucene-fix; echo worktree=M01-lucene-fix commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD); cp $O/dl/gradle/lucene-gradle-wrapper-8.14.0.jar gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar; test $(sha256sum gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar | cut -c1-64) = $(cut -c1-64 gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar.sha256); rm -rf lucene/core/build/test-results/test; set +e; ./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain -Porg.gradle.java.installations.auto-download=false -Ptests.seed=DEADBEEF -Ptests.jvms=2 --max-workers=4  :lucene:core:jar :lucene:core:test --rerun --tests TestIndexSortSortedNumericDocValuesRangeQuery > $O/logs/M01-fix.online.gradle-log.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; set -e; echo gradle-exit=$rc; tail -5 $O/logs/M01-fix.online.gradle-log.txt; python3 -I $O/scripts/junit_summary.py lucene/core/build/test-results/test | tee $O/logs/M01-fix.online.junit.txt; test $(grep -o 'tests=[0-9]*' $O/logs/M01-fix.online.junit.txt | cut -d= -f2) -gt 0; test $(grep -o 'failures=[0-9]*' $O/logs/M01-fix.online.junit.txt | cut -d= -f2) -eq 0; test $(grep -o 'errors=[0-9]*' $O/logs/M01-fix.online.junit.txt | cut -d= -f2) -eq 0; J=$(ls lucene/core/build/libs/lucene-core-*.jar | grep -v -E 'sources|javadoc|tests' | head -1); cp $J $O/artifacts/M01-lucene-fix-core.jar; echo built-jar=$J; sha256sum $O/artifacts/M01-lucene-fix-core.jar;
